text_to_image_prompt: One compact tropical oceanfront flat-roof white villa to the right of a single long rectangular cyan infinity pool. Ocean to left; circular sunken lounge with cream cushions and round fire bowl at far short end; narrow stone paths; straight floating wood exterior stair at near end of villa; small wooden bar with three wicker stools at near-right. Teak roof has white daybed, brass telescope, slim dark/glass railings. No people, second pool or extra wings. Single elevated three-quarter architectural diorama on clean light neutral background, realistic materials, warm night lights and tropical palms, portrait layout with generous margins. Concept set design reference, not measured construction documentation.

Palms and potted tropical plants; warm night lights. Use coherent geometry and physically connected paths around pool. Keep it intimate single villa, no invented extra wings or second pool. No people or text, no dimensions. Render on clean light neutral backdrop as a physical architectural diorama, enough margins, clear spatial relationships.
